We need to analyze the trace and determine why the attempt failed. The task was to implement several changes to the humanize library. The agent explored the codebase, read files, ran existing tests (which all passed), then wrote a STATUS.json with probability estimates and concluded without making any actual code changes. The verifier flagged multiple failing hidden tests (m01, m03, m08, m27, m28, m29) and the agent's final message indicates they didn't implement changes. The failure appears to be that the agent did not actually perform the required code modifications (e.g., adding metric function, fixing intcomma, etc.). The prompt clearly asked to implement changes. The agent's trace shows they only read files, ran tests, and wrote STATUS.json but never edited any source code. So the cause is skill_gap? Or spec_defect? The task is doable; the agent just didn't do it. Possibly they misinterpreted the task or gave up? The trace ends with "STOP: agent_done" and they said "Further verification... would require access to the network... not possible." That suggests they thought they couldn't modify files? But they did write STATUS.json successfully, so they could have edited source files. They just didn't attempt to implement the required changes. So the cause is likely skill_gap: the policy lacked the skill or made a mistake (i.e., didn't actually implement the changes). Alternatively, could be budget? They used 25 steps, not too many. They didn't run out of steps. So not budget. The environment allowed file writes. So skill_gap is most appropriate.

Also, we need to evaluate solution_correct: Did the attempt actually satisfy every requirement? No, because the hidden tests failed and no code changes were made. So solution_correct is false.

Evidence: The trace shows they only read files and wrote STATUS.json, never modified any source code. Quoting: "Unfortunately, I couldn't directly implement the changes or verify them through testing due to the limitations of the environment." That indicates they didn't implement.

Thus, JSON: {"cause": "skill_gap", "solution_correct": false, "evidence": "Unfortunately, I couldn't directly implement the changes or verify them through testing due to the limitations of the environment.", "rationale": "The agent did not implement any of the required code changes, leaving all requirements unmet."}
